stories.title: Ogden woman to spend up to 15 years in prison for physical abuse of her son
stories.summary: An Ogden woman will spend up to 15 years imprisonment on three felony counts for physically abusing her young son.

stories.title: Undefeated season: No. 2 Utah blows past West Virginia to stay unbeaten in Morgan Scalley's first season
stories.summary: Utah rolled to a victory over the visiting Mountaineers and secured its third undefeated season in the modern era of college football

stories.title: Mexico's government is slamming a DEA crime tip line as foreign interference. Others are thrilled.
stories.summary: The Mexican government is railing against the U.S. Drug Enforcement Agency's anonymous tip line for reports against criminals and corrupt officials in the Latin American nation.

stories.title: Summit County resident gets stolen puppies back after finding them listed for sale online
stories.summary: Stolen puppies listed for sale on an online website

stories.title: Utah looks at data center guardrails as the national pushback continues
stories.summary: As plans edge ahead for a nuclear-powered data center in Carbon County, just one of many data center proposals in Utah, officials are mulling guardrails.

stories.title: 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' proves the value of dystopian stories
stories.summary: Unlike many prequels and sequels in other franchises, "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" functions perfectly well as a standalone movie.

stories.title: Stocks jump to close out an erratic week that was also Wall Street's best in more than a year
stories.summary: Stocks jumped and nudged Wall Street to its best week in more than a year following several days of erratic swings for influential technology companies.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? A pup on a paddleboard
stories.summary: A man and his dog shared the sea on this paddleboard ride on the Big Island of Hawaii.

stories.title: Sandy man federally charged for carjacking 2 vehicles at gunpoint
stories.summary: A Sandy man is facing federal charges after he was arrested for trying to carjack two separate vehicles at gunpoint before successfully stealing one and fleeing from police.

stories.title: Ben McAdams is returning to Congress
stories.summary: When Ben McAdams returned to Capitol Hill earlier this month, he attended the orientation all new lawmakers must complete before being sworn in. But for McAdams, it was really more of a brush-up.

stories.title: Utah shoppers keep spending despite higher prices this holiday season
stories.summary: Economists say holiday spending is expected to grow, even as inflation and rising costs leave many Utah families feeling financially strained.

stories.title: Discovery of an Egyptian structure hidden for 2,600 years offers clues to ancient engineering
stories.summary: Archaeologists have rediscovered an ancient Egyptian structure that was hidden for nearly 2,600 years, with the first clues spotted from space.
